mission: Định nghĩa Levenshtein Distance chuẩn và thuật toán; thực thể trung tâm

sample_evidence.excerpt: The Levenshtein algorithm, also known as edit distance, measures the minimum number of edit operations required to transform one sequence into another. The standard operations are insertion, deletion, and substitution.

Levenshtein distance is defined over sequences, which means that the representation of text matters when Unicode is involved. Depending on the implementation, a string may be processed as code units, Unicode code points, or grapheme clusters.
